evidence: Milestone capacity and demand scenarios for enclosed communities; no commissioning dates, market forecasts or demonstrated lunar-gravity manufacturing premium.
reading_rule: B=1e9U,T=1e12U. One common real U, not future dollars. Annual milestone outputs; Earth-equivalent 24 h visitor nights. Positive assigned cash follows facility costs, renewal, growth, own debt and the stated extra shared-services allowance. Negative gaps remain explicit. Capital and cash are not additions to prior macroeconomic totals.

boundaries: Local community purchases are not external sales. All represented exports must have independent buyers, outside the same joint construction budget.
Destination receipts exclude access fares; no lunar carrier surplus is assumed. The calculation covers inbound exports only, not a complete bilateral trade/current account.
Capital includes visitor accommodation, pressure/shielding/utility capacity and allocated attraction/access facilities as a hypothetical price per bed. No engineering bill validates this allowance.
Factory feed, yield, energy, costs and finished-product mix require design. No raw-mining cash is added separately. No physical gravity productivity premium is assigned.

Commercial operations include staff compensation and specified fixed costs. Additional shared public-service needs use a separate allowance; permanent resident housing, its funding and all other household activities require their own accounts.
New facility loans and sponsor/equity capital remain visible. Capital overlaps with the mature ordinary allowance must be reconciled before combining models.
These are alternative milestone sizes, not an adopted calendar or automatic sequence. Bed supply is independent of human staffing.

The development allocation assumes sponsor/equity owners permit that use of residual cash. No mandatory equity dividend or complete cost of equity is priced; required distributions would reduce the contribution.
